name: actionshub-chef-install
description: Installs Chef or Cinc on your build agent with ease

channel.description: Chef Channel to install, stable or current

project.description: Which Chef or Cinc project to install

version.description: Version to install. Defaults to latest for workstation installs

license.description: Chef Downloads license ID. Required for Chef Community/Commercial downloads; not used for Cinc.

omnitruckUrl.description: Deprecated: Omnitruck base url. Use for Cinc or other omnitruck-compatible endpoints.

windowsPath.description: Path to the root of the install on Windows. Override this for non-default products such as Cinc.
